office_does: The County Clerk runs the Clerk's Office and is the executive officer of the Superior Court: it processes and keeps court records and exhibits and collects and pays out court fees, fines and restitution.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Clerk Billie A. Maggard (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Yakima County Clerk since January 2023, previously an in-court clerk and a longtime legal assistant; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Clerk since January 2023; earlier an in-court clerk for about four years and a legal assistant for almost 20 years [S3]
Named rebuilding relationships within the office and with other departments as her biggest project [S3]
Set electronic filing of court documents as a priority [S3]
